text.p: Italian bonds and futures sharply pared earlier gains and closed near support just off day's lows after turning into negative territory in afternoon business on a wave of profit-taking after failing to test highs, traders said.
They noted the Italian market moved in line with German bunds and Spanish bonos but the undertone was not particularly bearish, just without any new ideas or direction.

"Just as we rose this morning without any real reason, so we came down in the afternon," one trader said. The market was watching government/trades union developments over the 1997 budget due to be debated in the lower house on Wednesday.
